name: linkding
language: Python/Django web app with database migrations, docs folder
notes: Case: a self-hosted web app (Django, SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations, JavaScript frontend) with a documentation site in docs/. Ground truth = documentation changes between v1.44.0 and v1.47.0 that the v1.47.0 code supports, plus one gap the maintainers never fixed: bundles got the database fields filter_unread and filter_shared (migration 0054) and the API serializer returns them, but api.md still shows bundles without them. Left out: community, hosting and acknowledgement pages, the auth-proxy and extension-store advice (deployment knowledge, not code) and wording changes.

items.what: LD_SUPERVISOR_MANAGED (experimental, default False): supervisor manages background tasks and uwsgi, task logs go to the container output.

LD_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_HOSTS: by default metadata, preview images and PDF snapshots are not loaded from internal hosts (SSRF protection); comma-separated hosts, IPs, CIDR ranges, .domain or * allow them.
LD_DISABLE_LOGIN_FORM (default False) hides the username/password form so only OIDC login remains.
LD_SESSION_COOKIE_AGE sets the session cookie lifetime in seconds, default 1209600 (2 weeks).
LD_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: comma-separated origins allowed to call /api/* from a browser; enables CORS for the API only.
LD_USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST (default false) trusts X-Forwarded-Host over Host.

items.anchor: When using `POST`, at least all required fields must be provided (currently only `url`).
items.what: The update section means PUT (full update) requires all required fields; auto tagging rules are applied on every update and merged into tag_names.
Bundles have the fields filter_unread and filter_shared (values off, yes, no; default off) in responses and payloads (migration 0054, BookmarkBundleSerializer).

items.anchor: Linkding can automatically create HTML snapshots
items.what: A URL that points to a PDF is downloaded and stored as an asset instead of creating an HTML snapshot.
Formatting uses ruff (Python), djlint (templates) and prettier; make lint runs ruff.
Development server and frontend are started with make serve and make frontend; management commands run with uv run manage.py.
